if both of you live abroad, need to start from the embassy, then move here together to israel and apply from
israel online. your husband needs a work visa in israel even if he works for a company abroad (tax wise its a bit more complicated even). 
check our articles about the process: https://aic.org.il/the-gradual-process-birds-eye-view/ and https://aic.org.il/partner-visa-in-israel-step-by-step-guide-to-your-first-visa/
